bio: Jason "PACO" Nunes serves as percussion visual coordinator for the World Class Bluecoats Drum & Bugle Corps, the 2016 DCI World Champions. His drum corps performing experience includes the Boston Crusaders (2007) and Carolina Crown (2008-2009). He went on to teach with the Boston Crusaders Drum and Bugle Corps from 2010 to 2012 before joining the Bluecoats' drumline educational staff.

Jon Popham is a visual instructor and drill designer from Georgetown, Kentucky. His drum corps career began in 2009 marching trumpet with the Glassmen, and he joined their visual staff after aging out in 2010. He served on the Blue Knights visual staff from 2013 to 2022 and has worked as a visual instructor with The Cavaliers, including for their 75th anniversary season. He holds degrees from the University of Kentucky and the University of the Cumberlands and teaches special education at Williamstown High School.

Joe Paul brings over 30 years of experience in the pageantry arts. He was a performing and staff member of both Avatar Winter Guard and The Cavaliers Drum & Bugle Corps from Rosemont, Illinois. He previously served on The Cavaliers' administrative team and as Director of Operations for The Academy Drum & Bugle Corps. He holds a B.A. in Art from California State University, Northridge, and works professionally as a graphic designer in Los Angeles.

Josh Scott is currently the Assistant Band Director at Round Rock High School, in Round Rock, Texas. Since 2007, Mr. Scott has served as a visual and brass instructor with the Phantom Regiment Drum and Bugle Corps, where he was a member from 2003-2006. Previously he has taught with the Colts Drum and Bugle Corps and The Academy Drum and Bugle Corps. Scott holds performance degrees from Butler University (Bachelor of Music, 2007) and Arizona State University (Master of Music, 2012).

Justin Samuels is a full-time visual designer and educator with extensive experience in the marching arts. He has worked in the drum corps community with The Cadets (2021) as Assistant Visual Caption Head and Choreographer, and later with The Bluecoats, where he assisted with visual production and choreography while leading the marching fundamentals program from 2022-2025. During his tenure, The Bluecoats won the 2024 Drum Corps International World Championship and received the John Brazale Outstanding Visual Performance Award in both 2024 and 2025. In addition to his drum corps work, Justin serves as Visual Caption Head and Choreographer for Broken Arrow High School (OK).

Kevin Fenske is an Austin-based music educator with degrees from the University of Houston (Bachelor of Music in music education) and the University of Texas at Austin (Master of Music in euphonium performance). He is a proud alumnus of the 7-time DCI World Champion Santa Clara Vanguard Drum and Bugle Corps and currently serves as a low brass technician for the Bluecoats Drum and Bugle Corps. He won a bronze medal at the 2018 Leonard Falcone International Euphonium and Tuba Festival and directs the Texas Low Brass Academy.
